segments.name: investment portfolio
segments.description: Holds a portfolio of real estate securities and earns interest and other income from it.
segments.evidence: We derive the substantial portion of our revenues and income from our investment portfolio.

segments.name: Constructive
segments.description: Originates business purpose loans through a wholly owned subsidiary.
segments.evidence: With our acquisition of Constructive, we commenced the operation of a new business segment, the direct origination of business purpose loans through a wholly-owned subsidiary.

revenueModel.text: It earns interest and other income from the securities it holds and the loans Constructive originates.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive the substantial portion of our revenues and income from our investment portfolio.

changes.text: Bought the half of Constructive it did not own in 2025, reporting two segments since.
changes.evidence: As a result of the acquisition of the outstanding 50% ownership interests in Constructive that were not previously owned by the Company on July 15, 2025, the Company currently operates in two reportable segments: (i) investment portfolio and (ii) Constructive.
